messages:
Asha (Partnerships): Quick sync — running the Partner Spotlight track at Summit. Need to lock speaker order, demo fallback plan, and swag rota. Please confirm by EOD Friday. Link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/partner-spotlight (comments only)
Lina (BizDev): I'll confirm AcmeCloud and NorthStar speaker names today. Asking partners for a 1-slide static fallback and a short bio.
Marco (Hardware PM): For on-site rigs: need 220V, two power strips, and a non-slip mat under the chassis. Can we reserve an extra table for hardware?
Priya (Marketing): Swag plan: 10:00-13:00 stickers + postcards, 13:00-16:30 tees + stickers, 16:30-17:30 promo cards only. Need volunteers per slot. I'll post signup after we lock shifts.
Sam (Events): AV checklist: 2 lapels, 1 handheld, HDMI switcher for 3 inputs, local router for isolated demo network. @LogisticsBot confirm adapters and spares. Green room 30m before show.
LogisticsBot: Staging inventory: HDMI adapters x6, USB-C adapters x5, lapel mics x2, handheld mics x1, spare batteries x15, tables reserved x3. Swag pallet TRK-55221 ETA Fri 07:00. Extra table request queued.
Marco (Hardware PM): I'll provide a 90s pre-recorded clip for the hardware demo in case power or network fails. File: hw_spotlight_backup.mp4, due Wed noon.
Diego (Eng): Demo order suggestion to reduce warmups: (1) marketplace search (stateless), (2) on-device quantized demo (pre-warmed / backup video), (3) Dedicated cluster stress demo last. Also adding a warmup job for Dedicated.
Priya (Marketing): Partners asked for a brief privacy line on slides. Suggest: "No customer data is stored; only transient tokens used for demo inference." Thoughts?
Asha (Partnerships): That sentence works. Add to runbook. Also add curl fallback snippet for partners if Dedicated fails to serve.
Diego (Eng): Curl fallback snippet for partners:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<prompt>","max_tokens":64}'
```
Lina (BizDev): Partners asked about a private 20-min integrator lab after the talk. We have a breakout at 16:40. Shall we offer two 20-min slots? RSVP required, max 12 each.
Priya (Marketing): I'll create the RSVP form and partner-facing agenda. Will include "bring a sample prompt" note.
Sam (Events): Venue network: VLAN request pending. If denied, we bring a pre-seeded local router. UPS units x2 assigned to demo table.
Asha (Partnerships): Great. Final: add any unresolved items as comments in the runbook doc. Dry-run scheduled Thu 14:00; please be in green room 30m prior. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
